title: I just built an AI-powered text battle game – Taleborn
author: Hawkvoice
selftext:
I just launched an AI-powered hero generation and ELO battle game.  
I know it sounds a little weird, but that’s probably the best way to describe it, lol.

I’ve always wanted to make a game (my first job was as a manager at a video game company), but since I’m not a programmer, it always felt out of reach. As AI got better, I realized I could actually build a simple text-based game.

Originally, I wanted to create something like AI Dungeon—where you make your own hero and explore random AI-generated dungeons. But I quickly realized that AI-generated stories can be kind of predictable, lack real creativity, and often feel inconsistent.

However, I found that the hero creation part was genuinely fun, so I decided to pivot. Instead of focusing on story, I built it into more of an AI-driven battle simulator—because let’s be honest, people naturally love competition.

So here it is: **Taleborn**. You can grab it on the App Store:  
[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taleborn-ai-hero-arena-fight/id6749387618](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taleborn-ai-hero-arena-fight/id6749387618)

It’s still in the early stages, so I’d love to hear your feedback!! Any thoughts would be super appreciated!
